messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: is there a way to load the Deducer package without using JGR?
parts:
yes, you can load deducer in the usual way (i.e. library(Deducer) ).
Or is you want to load deducer with no gui elements, you can use:

options(DeducerNoGUI=TRUE)
library(Deducer)
